subject.title: fix(msteams): add timeouts to file consent upload requests

question: Should this PR wait for and reuse the shared abortable transfer-timeout helper from https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104288, or may it land first with required follow-up consolidation?
rationale: Both fixes are valid and cover distinct upload paths, but landing both branches as written creates duplicate timeout ownership; their integration and landing order require maintainer coordination.

options.title: Land shared owner first
options.body: Merge the related timeout-owner change, update this PR to consume it, and then land the consent fix without parallel policy.

options.title: Land consent fix first
options.body: Accept this focused implementation now and require the related PR or an immediate follow-up to consolidate both paths.

options.title: Keep helpers separate
options.body: Explicitly accept independent timeout helpers and constants for the two upload paths despite future drift risk.

recommendation.title: Land shared owner first
recommendation.body: Merge the related timeout-owner change, update this PR to consume it, and then land the consent fix without parallel policy.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows repeated ownership of the consent helper surface, and this decision concerns integration between two concurrent Microsoft Teams timeout changes.
